newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Piercing Pagoda a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Piercing Pagoda a buy.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Ed Weller started coverage of Piercing Pagoda Inc, a retailer of moderately priced gold jewelry in mall kiosks.
-- said the company is more than 10 times the size of its nearest competitor, giving it "overwhelming dominance" in the market and providing a clear indication of good management.
-- noted the company is "earning very attractive rates of return on investment."
-- estimated sales will grow 30 percent in the fiscal year ending March 1998. sees earnings at $1.61 a share in fiscal 1998 and $1.95 in fiscal 1999.
-- shares were at 25-1/8, up 1/8, in late morning trade.
